purpose: Define secret references as opaque exact bindings to logical secret identities, never raw secret values or filename/environment heuristics.

topics.name: Secret Reference
topics.purpose: Define secret references as opaque exact bindings to logical secret identities, never raw secret values or filename/environment heuristics.

semantics.opaque_rule: Reference does not expose secret material.
semantics.resolve_rule: Runtime resolution is explicit and governed.
semantics.env_rule: Environment-variable names may be bindings only when declared; they are not the secret semantic identity.
semantics.file_rule: Secret files/paths are storage bindings only.
semantics.failure_rule: Unresolved secret ref hard-fails protected operation rather than substituting empty/default material.
semantics.authority_rule: Ability to reference a secret does not imply ability to reveal/export it.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: missing secret replaced with empty string
env var name treated as canonical secret identity
